Version 2.0.0 — Major rewrite and philosophy update for NoPUA Lite.

- Rewritten manifesto: concise Daoist-inspired principles for AI task perseverance, motivation, and completeness without fear-based methods.
- Introduces "Three Beliefs", "Way of Water" failure recovery process, cognitive escalation tiers, and self-guiding questions.
- Emphasizes minimally intrusive footprint (~1.5k tokens), suitable for small models and personal use.
- Defines clear activation triggers, success verification standards, and responsible handoff procedures.
- Focuses on respect, initiative, self-satisfaction, and thoughtful exits for all task types.
